resources.string: Copy text from apps, screenshots and images—entirely on your device.
Only the OCR runtime and selected language model are downloaded. Screenshots and recognized text are never uploaded or saved to history. No accessibility access is required.
Download the open-source OCR Pack once. The main app contains no OCR engine or model weights.
The OCR Pack is not published in this catalog yet. Refresh the packs catalog or install the signed pack APK from Tools Hub.
On-device OCR requires Android 7 or newer.
Download the text detector and selected language model to recognize text offline. Language models are separate downloads.
Download the text detector (if needed) and %1$s recognition model from ModelScope? Each file is SHA-256 verified before use. Mobile models are typically 8–20 MB per language.
Remove this language model? You can download it again. The shared text detector is kept for other languages.
Start capture, open another app, then tap the floating button to read text. Tap words to copy them, or choose a new region. Long-press the button to stop. Android blocks capture of protected screens.
Allow MP Manager to display over other apps for the capture button. It appears only while you have a capture session running.
Android will ask which screen to share. Choose the entire screen to copy text across apps. Only captures you request are recognized. Stop the session from the floating button or notification.
Tap the floating button to read text. Stop when finished.
Could not capture this screen. Try again or import a screenshot.
Drag over text, or read the full image
No text found. Try a tighter region, a different language, or a clearer image. Protected screens cannot be read.
Tap words to select them. Long-press a line to select it. Pinch to zoom; drag to pan when zoomed. You can also edit the text below.

PaddleOCR mobile models (Baidu / PaddlePaddle Authors), distributed by RapidOCR: Apache License 2.0. ONNX Runtime (Microsoft and contributors): MIT License. Models are pinned to the RapidOCR v3.10.0 model registry. Recognition uses no cloud service.
